svg.title: Mockup A — Default Lot View (Project: Studio Visual Direction 01)
svg.desc: Non-production reference mockup. Not an implementation asset. No production code.

g.text: Click a building or person to inspect.
Double-click to focus · Esc to clear
Reference only. Not an implementation asset. Illustrative lot geometry stands in for the real URP scene.
1 · Top HUD: one band, three zones
over 15px caps. Active speed is a filled brass
chip. This replaces the cream strip entirely.
Rails are 212px and 310px on 1600px; the world
holds ~67% of width and all of the centre. No
panel sits over the lot at rest. The camera is
composed on the lot — not on a road.
Warm spill = work. Open hot doors + red beacon
= shooting. Shut and unlit = dark. The attention
pin is anchored to the building that owns it,
never floated in a corner alert list.
Glyph · title · phase line · one truth line ·
naked %. Attention rows carry icon + shape +
Composition: UX North Star §8. Top HUD: §9. Rail: §10.2–10.3. Six segments = the six ProductionPhase values in src/core/types.ts:561.
Phase rail freezes and appends "Held N weeks" on a block — it must not creep (Package 05 §12.2). Nothing here invents a lifecycle state.
Non-stage buildings carry no resting nameplate here — by Annex §A5 a nameplate appears on selection or attention, so Development reads as a lit window only.
Absent by design: invented scene/shot counts, naked percentages, colour-only status, collapsed "Stage issue (2)" alerts, auto-camera on alert.
